name: Central bank stress
summary: RBA hikes to an 18-year high; Bank of England expected to raise rates on 5 Nov
state: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate to 4.85% on 3 Nov, its fifth rise this year, on a 6–3 vote (ABC). The Bank of England is expected to raise Bank Rate to 4% on 5 Nov, its first rise since 2023 (IG). The Fed held at 3.75–4% on 28 Oct. Policymakers face a stagflationary dilemma; no emergency move had been made.
for_you: Variable mortgage and loan rates are rising in several countries; savings rates tend to follow.
rubric_hit: Stagflationary dilemma across major banks = Watch

sources.title: ABC News — RBA lifts rates to highest level in 18 years
IG — BoE preview: Bank set to lift rates to 4%

why: Central banks are the shock absorbers; when they are boxed in or their independence is challenged, markets lose their backstop.
drivers: Inflation vs growth trade-off, political pressure, currency moves, financial stability.

rubric.alert: Emergency inter-meeting moves, attempt to remove a central-bank head, or coordinated intervention.
rubric.watch: Stagflationary dilemma, open political pressure on a major central bank, or FX intervention by a G7 bank.
rubric.normal: Fed, ECB and BoJ acting orderly and on schedule; independence unquestioned.
